imageQa.note: Intentional image-free editorial layouts. The weekender-bag and home-tool-kit guides use accurate Amazon category text links only; no editorial, affiliate or product image is added or changed.

searchConsole.signal: Six HTTPS-homepage impressions, one HTTP-homepage impression, zero clicks, average position 1.3, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster; the sitemap snapshot reports 26 submitted and zero indexed URLs.
searchConsole.decision: The homepage-only sample is too small for a Data-led item. The batch therefore adds one authority asset and two unrelated explorations while reinforcing discovery through the homepage, Life and Style hubs, reciprocal links, Library search and sitemap.
searchConsole.ignored: The handful of homepage impressions, HTTP variant, aggregate position and stale sitemap snapshot were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or a new query-family page; they informed crawl-path reinforcement only.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed sponsored/nofollow category text links appear on each of the weekender-bag and home-tool-kit guides. The credit-card billing-dispute guide remains commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy credit-card billing-dispute control file with a statement-date deadline calculator, issue classification, evidence index, merchant-and-issuer chronology, written-notice proof, investigation ledger and closure audit grounded in current CFPB regulation and FTC guidance.
authority.cluster: Consumer documentation and household financial administration, with reciprocal paths from missing-package, consumer-complaint, identity-theft and records-retention guides; the other pages open distinct short-trip packing and basic home-maintenance clusters.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified factual-review opportunities were logged for the CFPB and FTC consumer-education teams; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life and Style: how to preserve a credit-card billing-error claim, how to choose one bag for a short trip, and how to build a task-based household tool kit. The authority page is noncommercial; the two buying guides solve distinct travel and home-maintenance problems, and none follows the unsupported Search Console sample.
